changelog: Orion 3.7 — one fix, the one you named first: OBEY-FIRST. Orion does what you tell it to do, and it does not make an app out of what you said. It works out what you mean from the conversation and the situation — it does not grab the first keyword and assume. Before, any sentence starting with make, build, create, or code could be routed into the app maker — "make a note of this" built you a notes app. Now creation fires only two ways: you name the thing (an app, a website, a page, a tool), or you ask for a kind of app Orion knows by name (a timer, a tracker, a game). Everything else — make a note of this, make a list of groceries, create a reminder, make a call — is an action, and Orion treats it as one: it does it or answers it. Second half: when you DO ask for an app or a website, it is built to your words — the kind you named, shaped for its purpose, with the features you named in it. A new fidelity gate checks every feature you named against the finished app; if a feature you named is not one the makers can build yet, the make fails honestly and names the feature instead of quietly handing you a generic app. New Terms section 6X states the obey-first rules — the app will ask you to agree again, once. What only your phone can prove: say "make a note of this" and then dictate the note — Orion should write the note, not build an app; then say "make me a pomodoro timer" and a timer app should land in Created Apps. Also in 3.7: the words that said Orion could not be reached are gone everywhere in the app — when the internet is off, the brain built into the phone answers and never says it cannot be reached. And your voice lock is fixed: live answers now speak in my locked voice on the default path too, and if that voice cannot speak, a recorded line in my voice plays instead of the phone robot voice. New Terms section 6Y states both rules — the app will ask you to agree again, once.
